methodology.summary: Estimated status values refresh automatically on every pipeline run. Temporary residents use the latest quarterly total; the remaining resident categories are scaled from the latest census resident shares so the estimate reconciles exactly to the latest Canada population total.
methodology.actual_definition: Actual uses the latest published figure for each category independently.
methodology.estimated_definition: Estimated uses a common-date snapshot anchored to the latest total population and temporary resident total.
